hooks.name: 会话启动：检查 LLM 环境配置
hooks.description: 会话启动时检查仓库内 backend/.env。只报告 key 是否仍是占位符，不打印 key 本身。路径相对仓库根。

action.command:
ENV_FILE="backend/.env"
if [ ! -f "$ENV_FILE" ]; then
  echo "backend/.env is missing. Copy backend/.env.example and set LLM_API_KEY, or run ./start.sh once so it creates the file."
elif grep -Eq '^LLM_API_KEY=(your_api_key_here|demo-key|sk-xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx)?[[:space:]]*$' "$ENV_FILE"; then
  echo "LLM_API_KEY in backend/.env is missing or still a placeholder. Edit it before ./start.sh. The value is not printed."
else
  echo "backend/.env has an LLM_API_KEY set. The value is not printed."
fi
echo "Bio-House educational sandbox. Not a diagnostic device."
echo "Start: ./start.sh"
